trans-unit.source: My, that was a wonderfully soothing tune he played.
trans-unit.target: My, that was a wonderfully soothing tune he played.

trans-unit.source: Wasn't it? Performances that good only come once in a blue moon.
trans-unit.target: Wasn't it? Performances that good only come once in a blue moon.

trans-unit.source: I feel we owe the bartender of the Adventurer's Guild for showing us.
trans-unit.target: I feel we owe the bartender of the Adventurer's Guild for showing us.

trans-unit.source: That was probably just a ploy to get you to spread the word about his place.
trans-unit.target: That was probably just a ploy to get you to spread the word about his place.

trans-unit.source: I want to hear it again.
trans-unit.target: I want to hear it again.

trans-unit.source: We can do that as much as we want later. We've got urgent work to do.
